explication: htop is a cross-platform interactive process and system monitor. The main workflow samples platform data, presents processes and system meters in a terminal interface, and lets users inspect, configure, and act on processes. The graph combines documented capabilities with the supplied ScreenManager and platform excerpts; several subsystem links are based on the README and tree rather than sampled implementation. Platform-specific collection is represented by Linux files, with other platform implementations also present.
